style: Third-person open-world game cutscene look, live-action cinematic photorealism, shallow depth of field, steady game-camera motion, no anime, no illustration

world.name: Kasumi East floor
world.lock: Fictional open-plan office called Kasumi East: beige fabric cubicle partitions, light oak desks, grey carpet aisles, morning fluorescent tubes mixed with cool east window light, a few rubber plants, plain office doorways, no readable letters on any surface

mio.lock: 27-year-old Japanese woman, adult face, shoulder-length black hair with a small matte clip on the right, cream blouse, navy pencil skirt, sheer black tights, low black block heels, a beige canvas tote on one shoulder, a navy lanyard with a blank white badge, tired calm morning expression, natural makeup

aoki.lock: Japanese man in his mid 40s, adult face, short black hair, navy security vest over a white shirt, sometimes a dark necktie, dark trousers, black office shoes, a blank badge on the vest, a clipboard in one hand, bored calm morning expression

kuroki.lock: Japanese man in his late 40s, short black hair, thin metal glasses, charcoal suit jacket, white shirt, a dark necktie, black office shoes, looks at papers, unhurried

nana.lock: 29-year-old Japanese woman, adult face, short brown bob, pale blue blouse, grey slacks, sits at a desk with a mug, mild morning expression

beats.place: Open-plan aisle at morning, a beige cubicle partition at the left, grey carpet running toward a window wall
beats.camera: Third-person camera at Mio's left side at shoulder height, her body in profile to the aisle, holding still with a slight breathing bob
beats.action: Mio crouches in profile beside the cubicle partition, knees chest neck and face all aimed down the aisle, tote on her shoulder, while Aoki walks slowly toward her down the aisle with a clipboard; nobody else is in frame
beats.sfx: HVAC hum, distant keyboard taps, one soft footstep on carpet
beats.music: Low pulsing synth bass with a single taiko hit at the start; holds under the whole clip

beats.place: The same open-plan aisle, beige cubicle partitions, grey carpet, morning fluorescent light
beats.camera: Third-person camera at Mio's left at shoulder height, a half-step closer on the tote swing, then holding as Aoki sits
beats.action: Mio rises from the squat and swings the beige canvas tote in a short arc into Aoki's left shoulder and upper chest. The tote hits square. Aoki's torso folds to his right, knees buckle, the clipboard slides onto the grey carpet, and he sits down hard unhurt, still breathing. Mio steps past him down the aisle without looking back
beats.sfx: Canvas thud, clipboard clack on carpet, HVAC hum
beats.music: Bass holds; one taiko hit on the tote contact

beats.place: A plain beige corridor wall beside an open office doorway, grey carpet, morning fluorescent light
beats.camera: Third-person camera at Mio's left side at shoulder height, her body in profile to the doorway, holding still with a slight breathing bob
beats.action: Mio stands in profile at the open doorway, knees chest neck and face all aimed into the inner office; Kuroki stays seated at the inner desk looking down at papers; both stay in these spots
beats.sfx: Quiet corridor, paper rustle from the inner room, HVAC
beats.music: Bass holds; a sparse tick on the downbeat

beats.place: Inside the small inner office: a wood desk, a black rolling chair, morning window light, the doorway behind Mio
beats.camera: Third-person camera just inside the doorway at Mio's left shoulder, holding on Kuroki's chair as it rolls back
beats.action: Mio steps in and swings a stack of blank copy paper in a short sideways arc into Kuroki's left forearm and shoulder. The sheets scatter upward and fall. Kuroki's torso sinks into the chair back, the chair rolls two feet on the carpet, he stays seated unhurt with glasses slightly askew, one sheet left in his hand. Mio gives a small bow and is already at the doorway
beats.sfx: Paper flutter, chair casters on carpet, HVAC
beats.music: Bass holds; a taiko hit on the paper contact

beats.place: The same inner office after the paper has settled, morning window light
beats.camera: Static medium two-shot at eye level, a very slow push-in
beats.action: Kuroki sits in the rolled-back chair holding one sheet, looks at Mio in the doorway and speaks; Mio stands in the doorway and answers without turning back; both stay in these spots
beats.sfx: Quiet office, one paper settling, HVAC
beats.music: Soft warm pad, the bass rests

beats.place: The same open-plan office, a light oak desk row with beige partitions, morning window light, the whole shot stays this desk row
beats.camera: Third-person camera in the aisle at shoulder height, Nana seated at left, Mio walking the aisle toward the far desks
beats.action: Mio walks the aisle past Nana's desk row; Nana sits with both hands on a white mug and looks up; both stay in this desk row
beats.sfx: Soft footsteps on carpet, a mug on wood, distant printer

beats.place: The same light oak desk row, Nana seated at left, an empty neighboring desk beside her, Mio standing in the aisle, morning window light
beats.camera: Third-person side two-shot at desk height, Nana at left, Mio close in the aisle at right, holding then following the mug
beats.action: Mio steps past; the hanging beige tote swings into the white mug on Nana's desk. The mug slides onto the empty neighboring desk between them, a thin brown coffee arc follows. Nana's torso leans into the chair back, the chair rolls, she stays seated unhurt. Mio's gaze turns toward the neighboring desk
beats.sfx: Ceramic slide, a small splash, chair casters, HVAC
beats.music: A short synth stab on the mug contact, then the bass

beats.place: A light oak desk in a beige cubicle, black mesh chair, morning window light behind the monitors, a white mug on the desk
beats.camera: Over-the-shoulder third-person camera behind Mio at the chair, holding still
beats.action: Mio sits in the chair, rests her right hand on the mouse, and stays still; the white mug sits on this desk; the tote sits on the carpet; the desk stays this cubicle
beats.sfx: Chair wheels on carpet, a mouse click, HVAC
beats.music: Bass returns with a slow taiko pattern
